# Brackets, quotes, and emphasis

Text inside brackets, quotes, or emphasis belongs together,
so a long line breaks before or after such a span but never inside it.

## Brackets

The release job signs every artifact it uploads to the download page (the signing key never leaves the build agent) before it tags the commit.

The release job signs every artifact it uploads to the download page [the signing key never leaves the build agent] before it tags the commit.

The release job signs every artifact it uploads to the download page {the signing key never leaves the build agent} before it tags the commit.

## Quotes

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded "with the size and checksum of each artifact" once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded 'with the size and checksum of each artifact' once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded “with the size and checksum of each artifact” once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded ‘with the size and checksum of each artifact’ once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded «with the size and checksum of each artifact» once the upload finishes.

## Emphasis and code

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded *with the size and checksum of each artifact* once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded _with the size and checksum of each artifact_ once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded **with the size and checksum of each artifact** once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded ~~with the size and checksum of each artifact~~ once the upload finishes.

The release job prints a short summary of every artifact it uploaded `with the size and checksum of each artifact` once the upload finishes.
